title: Siren Drop 220 (instrumental, 1:30)

[Intro - instrumental, a single rising-pitch siren sweeping upward, no drums, tension builds]

[Drop - instrumental, sudden hard drop, deep continuous distorted 808 bass shred, triplet 808 snares on top]

[Drop - instrumental, deep 808 bass shred, rapid triplet snare rolls, full energy]

[Outro - instrumental, siren fades out]
